info.name: 971 MMA — NexusOne Realtime Access Control
info.description:
# 971 MMA × SALTO NexusOne — Realtime Access Control API

This collection implements the **Realtime Access Control Integration — API Requirements v1** from SALTO Systems (NexusOne middleware).

## Production base URL

```
{{base_url}}
```

All endpoints are **POST**, **JSON** request/response, **HTTPS** only.

## Authorization

**Bearer token** (server-to-server). NexusOne must send:

```
Authorization: Bearer {{api_bearer_token}}
Content-Type: application/json
```

We will provide `api_bearer_token` separately (secure channel). Do not embed it in the mobile app.

## MemberId semantics

`MemberId` accepts either:
- **971 MMA app user UUID** (primary — from member profile / future biometric mapping), or
- **Mindbody client ID** (numeric string, e.g. `100006257`)

## QR / Card / PIN (Access by Media)

- **Production path for GT7:** `Type` = `"QR"`. `Data` = the full string scanned from the member's phone (issued by the 971 MMA app, ~5 minute TTL).
- QR format: `971mma:v2:supabase:<userId>:<expEpoch>:<jti>:<signature>`
- **Card** and **PIN** are accepted by the contract but return `Granted: false` in v1 (not used at this site).

## Access decision (Mindbody back-to-back)

For **Access by Media** and **Access by Member Id**, membership is validated **live against Mindbody** on each request (not a stale cache). Typical latency: 1–3 seconds.

## Response contract — access endpoints

Both access endpoints **always return HTTP 200** with:

```json
{ "Granted": true|false, "Message": "..." }
```

Denied access is expressed via `Granted: false`, not via HTTP error codes.

## Response contract — profile endpoint

Returns HTTP **200** with profile fields, or HTTP **400/401** with `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }` if member not found or auth fails.

## DeviceId

`DeviceId` must be the identifier of the GT7 / access point (e.g. serial or site label). We allow-list devices on first use; provide your production device IDs before go-live.

## UAT

Use folder **Appendix — UAT examples** for a denied-media sample. For a **granted** QR test, request a fresh sample `Data` value from 971 MMA (expires in 5 minutes).

---

**Contact:** 971 MMA engineering (integration handoff)

request.description:
## Get Profile by Member Id

Maps a member for NexusOne local profile / biometric use.

### Request
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| MemberId | String | App user UUID or Mindbody client ID |

### Response (200)
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| FirstName | String | |
| LastName | String | |
| FullName | String | Optional |
| DisplayName | String | Optional |
| ImageBase64 | String | Optional (profile photo, base64 payload without data-URI prefix) |

### Errors
- **401** — missing/invalid bearer token
- **400** — member not found

## Access Control by Member Id

Real-time grant/deny when the member is already identified (e.g. biometric resolution). Validates membership live via Mindbody.

### Request
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| MemberId | String | App user UUID or Mindbody client ID |
| DeviceId | String | GT7 / gate / access point identifier |

### Response (200)
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| Granted | Boolean | Grant or deny physical access |
| Message | String | User-facing message for display |

### Example messages
- Granted: `"Access granted."`
- Denied: `"No active membership found. Please contact front desk."`

item.name: 3. Access Control by Card / QR / PIN

request.description:
## Access Control by Card / QR / PIN

**Primary GT7 integration path.** NexusOne sends the scanned media payload; we validate the QR signature and call Mindbody live for the access decision.

### Request
| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| Data | String | Scanned payload (full QR string, card number, or PIN) |
| Type | String | `"QR"`, `"Card"`, or `"PIN"` |
| DeviceId | String | GT7 / gate / access point identifier |

### Response (200)
| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| Granted | Boolean | Grant or deny physical access |
| Message | String | User-facing message |

### Notes
- **QR (v1 production):** `Data` is the exact string displayed in the 971 MMA member app. TTL ~5 minutes.
- **Card / PIN:** contract-supported; v1 returns denied with unsupported message (not deployed at this site).
- Duplicate scans within ~30s may return `Granted: true` without a second Mindbody write (anti-bounce).
